existing_production_input.scope: Native headless production input dispatch smoke; no GPU or browser touch/feel claim; no16-itemfixes.

capture_method: Actual wall timestamps, Engine.time_scale=1, max-fps60, no fixed-fps. In-memory viewport capture; PNG compression after recording. MP4 preserves capture timestamps.
limits: Mesa llvmpipe software renderer at roughly 11-14 captured frames/sec, including input-to-render latency. Headless action measurements are 222/606 ms; recorded native visual contact is 396 ms and full settle 749 ms. No hardware GPU/browser/audio-listening claim.
